A woman, maybe 40s has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek is showing everyone a bushy plant with big trumpet flowers, white or purple, and spiny round pods by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The journal grows — the human way.
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek presses something into your hand. "Camu-camu — for what you did. Look for the leaves. You'll know it."
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek wanders over, just to talk. "You hear what Kayden said about the creek? ...Never mind. How are you holding up?"
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Right. Let's do it, then. Talking doesn't chop wood."
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek claps your shoulder. "You're doing better than you think." (+15 energy — morale is real.)
Sigrun showed A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek the Senegal Date Palm — "remember it." Word gets around.

💡 The tree with compound leaves and hard nuts — THAT's what A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek was describing. Hickory Nuts. It clicks like a key turning.
Sigrun showed A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek the Field Mustard — "remember it." Word travels before the lesson cools.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Clarice just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
